name: Universal Search
route: No live route — global SearchOverlay opened over the current route.
annotation: Global SearchOverlay, no live route — a single fast lane into all nine domains and every screen. Autofocused GlassPillInput leads a chip SegmentedTabs row; one purple-glow CIAInsightCard (full evidence + BtnCoach/BtnGhost pair) is the dominant focal moment above three source-honest ListRow groups (Goals, Habits, Recipes) in SolidCards. No bottom nav — overlay covers the active route; Cancel is the only exit.

modules.build: Standard iOS status bar, dark shell: 9:41 time left, signal/Wi-Fi/battery right, paper-100 icons on #0A0A0F. No back chevron — the overlay's only exits are the Cancel text button and swipe-down dismiss.

GlassPillInput variant=search, .glass-pill, autofocus. Leading search glyph. Placeholder "search everything" — Newsreader Medium Italic on "search," the screen's one italic-emphasis word. Trailing 44px clear "x" button (labeled "Clear search") + "Cancel" text button (labeled "Cancel search").

SegmentedTabs, chip styling, single-select category scope, horizontal scroll. Items: All (active — --surface-3 bg, orange label), Goals, Habits, Recipes, + (more). Drops to 40% opacity only in the zero-results state (nothing to scope).

CIAInsightCard .glass-card + glow-cia, purple pool, breathing 4s cycle. Line "CIA thinks you're looking for." [Habit] tag + title "Morning mobility." Subtitle "your usual Tuesday reset." Evidence row: ChipDomainTag [Fitness] + ChipProvenance "based on 6 Tuesdays." BtnCoach "Open routine" + BtnGhost "Not now" (a11y: "Dismiss suggestion").

SectionHeader overline "GOALS · 1 RESULT." SolidCard, 1 ListRow (56px min-height): title "Run a 5k," ChipDomainTag [Fitness], metric 60% orange progress fill, ChipProvenance "via Goals." Press: row scales .98, background shifts toward --surface-3, 150ms.

SectionHeader overline "HABITS · 1 RESULT." SolidCard, 1 ListRow: title "10k steps," ChipDomainTag [Fitness], metric "12-day streak" (tabular-nums), ChipProvenance "via Habits." Honest-null fallback (not shown here): "Not enough data yet" + chip "no data yet."
SectionHeader overline "RECIPES · 1 RESULT." SolidCard, 1 ListRow: title "Post-run bowl," ChipDomainTag [Nutrition] (#84cc16), metric "450 cal," ChipProvenance "via saved recipes."
HomeIndicator, system default, dark-shell styling. No floating Today/CIA/Goals/Me pill here — the SearchOverlay covers the active route and suspends the persistent tab nav while open.

trustControls: Every result metric carries a ChipProvenance ("via Goals," "via Habits," "via saved recipes") or an honest-null/low-confidence label — no fabricated metrics.

CIAInsightCard evidence row (ChipDomainTag [Fitness] + ChipProvenance "based on 6 Tuesdays") explains why the suggestion surfaced; BtnGhost "Not now" (announces "Dismiss suggestion") lets the person reject it without deleting history.
Recent-search ChipChoice history (default/empty-query state, not this composed view): tap re-runs a stored query, long-press deletes one — supports the delete-recommendation-history consent rule.

Offline: server-dependent categories (Recipes, Community) are hidden rather than shown stale; local categories (Goals, Habits, Journal, Notes, Settings, Screens) stay searchable — never a dishonest "may be outdated" claim.
Glyph-only controls carry explicit screen-reader labels: "Clear search," "Cancel search," "Fitness domain," "Nutrition domain."
notes: Composition shown is the spec's "typing / live suggestions" full-population state (CIA card + 3 result groups), not the cold-start default (10 recent ChipChoice, or first-use suggested-category chips) or the zero-result/error/offline/skeleton states — those are alternate States-section variants, not part of this composed default render. Route confirmed as no live route, global overlay; no bottom nav rendered because the overlay covers the active route (hasNav=false). Recipe provenance correctly reads "via saved recipes," not "via server" (infra language a person wouldn't recognize as a source). Italic word resolved to "search," appearing once inside the GlassPillInput placeholder "search everything" — the screen's single Newsreader/Tiempos italic-emphasis word; not fabricated elsewhere and not applied to the draft's mistaken "*search*" literal-asterisk form. Dropped the draft's standalone "divider/spacer" pseudo-module (not a cataloged component) and used it to add a HomeIndicator module instead, keeping modules at 8 while matching canon's status-bar + home-indicator-on-every-screen rule. Accessibility: paper-100 on --surface-2 #211008 computes to roughly 17.7:1 (AAA); paper-64% over the same surface roughly 7.7:1 (AAA); every ListRow, filter chip, and the clear/Cancel controls meet the 44px minimum touch target.
